calendar-plans.name: Another Sea Behind Another Wall
calendar-plans.description: A lifeguard in his late 60s from the Palestinian National Rescue Team-North District, who seems to be highly dedicated to his job, watches over the beaches of the sea.

calendar-plans.name: East of Eden
calendar-plans.description: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

calendar-plans.name: Stereotypical
calendar-plans.description: Stereotypical follows the life of Marvin, a sardonic anthropomorphic Turtle trying to navigate Forestville, a small town populated by people who seem determined to embody every small town stereotype imaginable. From oblivious neighbors, eccentric relatives, and overly strict HOA members, Marvin is constantly caught in the chaos created by the town's most ridiculous characters.
